questions.prompt: 400bb, in position, folded to you with 76s. Best default?

choices.text: Open. This is a high nut-potential hand when you are deep and last to act.
Fold. Deep stacks make suited connectors worse

questions.explanation: Very deep, suited connectors are a reason to play, not a fold.

questions.prompt: 350bb, you have top pair on the river and face a huge bet from a tight player. Best default?

choices.text: Fold most of the time. One pair does not beat a 300bb value bet.
Call because you were ahead on the flop
Call every river because you are deep

questions.explanation: Depth turns top pair into a bluff-catcher, and tight players under-bluff the river.

questions.prompt: 250bb, you flop the nut straight on a dry board. Best default?

choices.text: Bet for value over multiple streets. Do not check it away.
Jam 250bb into a tiny pot with no callers who can have anything

questions.explanation: You have the nuts and the stack to get paid. Build the pot. A single overbet is not the only way.

questions.prompt: 500bb effective, early position, KJo. Best default?

choices.text: Fold. Deep and early, this offsuit hand is dominated.

questions.explanation: The same hand that opens on the button at 100bb is a fold under the gun at 500bb.
